requirements.title: Procedure name interpretation depends on generic, specific, or unestablished status
requirements.definition: The rules for interpreting a procedure reference depend on whether the procedure name is established as generic, established only as specific, or not established in the scoping unit.

pending.procedure-name-generic-specific-unestabl: Use three same-spelled references in separate scoping units: an interface generic g returning sentinel 11, an EXTERNAL specific g returning 22, and an unestablished abs reference producing intrinsic ABS(-7)=7; each wrong category has a distinct exact result.

requirements.title: Declarations, USE association, and host association establish generic procedure names
requirements.definition: A procedure name is established as generic by a same-named interface block, GENERIC statement, INTRINSIC specification for a generic intrinsic, USE association from a module where the name is generic, or host association from a host where the name is generic and the local scoping unit has no declaration of that name.

pending.interface-block-establishes-generic: Create interface g with integer and real module specifics returning exact sentinels 11 and 12; a same-named external fallback would return 99, so wrong resolution is observable.
pending.generic-statement-establishes-generic: Use a GENERIC :: g => gi binding where gi returns 21, plus a same-spelled external control returning 99; verify g(1) yields 21.
pending.intrinsic-generic-establishes-generic: Declare INTRINSIC ABS and evaluate ABS(-7), expecting exact 7; companion external ABS would return 49, making wrong resolution observable.
pending.use-associated-generic-establishes-gener: USE a module exporting generic g whose integer specific returns 31; local external fallback returns 99 in a companion, and the USE case must produce 31.
pending.host-associated-generic-establishes-gene: Host defines generic g with integer specific returning 1 and inner procedure has no local declaration; inner evaluates g(0) and verifies 1. Companion inner procedure declares local integer external g returning 2 with the same reference spelling; g(0) verifies 2, proving the no-local-declaration condition on host generic establishment.

requirements.title: Procedure names are established only specific by specific definitions and declarations
requirements.definition: A procedure name is established only specific by a module subprogram, internal subprogram, statement function, subprogram self name, specific intrinsic specification, explicit EXTERNAL specification, USE association from a specific module name, or host association from a host where the name is specific and there is no local declaration.

pending.module-subprogram-establishes-specific: Module procedure f returns 11; a same-spelled generic in a companion scope returns 99, so f() must produce 11.
pending.internal-subprogram-establishes-specific: Internal function f returns 12; verify caller expression f()+30 equals 42.
pending.statement-function-establishes-specific: Statement function f(i)=i+13 yields f(29)=42, distinguishing it from an external f returning 99.
pending.subprogram-self-name-establishes-specifi: Recursive function self name f is used only as the function result identifier where allowed and returns 42; source-control companion keeps generic name separate.
pending.specific-intrinsic-establishes-specific: Declare INTRINSIC IABS and verify IABS(-42)=42, with an external IABS companion returning 99 for wrong resolution.
pending.external-attribute-establishes-specific: Declare integer external abs returning x+49; ABS(-7) in that scope resolves to the specific external result 42, not intrinsic 7.
pending.use-associated-specific-establishes-spec: USE a module procedure f returning 42 through its specific name; companion generic g with same result type returns 99.
pending.host-associated-specific-establishes-spe: Host internal specific g returns 1 and inner procedure with no local declaration calls g; verify 1. Companion inner procedure declares local integer external g returning 2 with the same reference spelling; g() verifies 2, proving a local specific declaration beats host specific establishment.

requirements.title: A procedure name with neither generic nor specific establishment is not established
requirements.definition: A procedure name is not established in a scoping unit exactly when it is neither established to be generic nor established to be specific.

pending.procedure-name-not-established-otherwise: In a scoping unit with no declaration for ABS, evaluate ABS(-7) and expect intrinsic fallback result 7 under later rules; companion with EXTERNAL ABS returning 42 proves that establishment status changes resolution.
